comment: Words that already exist, so the site quotes the business instead of inventing a personality for it. `captions` are verbatim from Habibi Haven's own Instagram (@habibi.haven), transcribed in research/BRAND-FACTS.md §4 — light emoji were dropped where a caption is used as running text, never the wording. `lines` are the strongest sentences from the copy bank preserved in research/COPY-BANK.md. If a caption is edited, edit the research file first and regenerate this one.
captions: Welcome to Habibi Haven, where every visit feels like coming home.
Come and enjoy our signature dish today — goat mandy.
Sip, savor, and stay a while. Every drink is a vibe.
Peach, please! This one is irresistible.
A Kenyan classic that never disappoints.
You asked, we listened — delivery is now available.
lines: A garden haven in the middle of the city.
A haven is not a place you pass through. It is a place you stay too long.
Three places to sit, and none of them rush you.
Come for the lamb chops. Stay for the third cup of chai.
541 reviews, and the same things keep coming up.
